name: product-designers-pack
description: Claude for Product Designers: 32 Claude skills for one piece of design work, from the request to the result, in eight stages: frame the problem with a problem framing brief, a user journey map and a HEART metrics plan; explore and decide with design principles, an options trade-off table, a rationale doc and a decision log; design with context through a design system rules file, a product context file, the user flow, the copy deck and every UI state; prototype around one question; critique against a quality bar, ten heuristics and an accessibility review; test with real users; hand off with a spec and a UX debt register; then show the impact in a review deck, a pushback brief, an impact write-up and a portfolio case study. For product designers, UX and UI designers, and designers who do their own research. Claude drafts, checks and explains; you make the design decisions, real users test the work, and nothing is presented as tested, accessible or ready to ship that was not.
